**1 — Scene:** Roast chicken leg quarter with a mixed green salad, a separate dressing cup, and a wrapped Magnum Mini ice cream. Water contributes no energy.

**2 — Vessels:** Chicken plate approximately **22 cm** diameter: area **380 cm²**. Salad bowl approximately **20 cm** diameter: area **314 cm²**. Dressing cup approximately **5 cm** diameter: area **20 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Chicken meat and skin; mixed salad leaves; tomato; cucumber; dressing; wrapped mini chocolate-coated ice cream. No separate quantity of cooking oil can be distinguished.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy:** Chicken estimates refer to edible meat and skin, excluding the visible bone. Salad components are allocated separate areas to avoid double-counting.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Gross volume calculation | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Roast chicken, meat and skin | 36% of plate | 137 cm² × 1.5 cm = 206 ml | 0.95 | 195 | 230 | 449 kcal |
| Mixed leaves | 55% of bowl | 173 cm² × 2.5 cm = 433 ml | 0.15 | 65 | 20 | 13 kcal |
| Tomato | 8% of bowl | 25 cm² × 1.4 cm = 35 ml | 0.60 | 21 | 18 | 4 kcal |
| Cucumber | 7% of bowl | 22 cm² × 1 cm = 22 ml | 0.60 | 13 | 15 | 2 kcal |
| Dressing | 80% of cup | 16 cm² × 1.5 cm = 24 ml | 1.00 | 24 | 350 | 84 kcal |
| Mini chocolate-coated ice cream | Wrapped; no vessel | Estimated bar envelope 9 × 4 × 1.7 cm = 61 ml | 0.82 | 50 | 320 | 160 kcal |

The salad covers approximately **70%** of its bowl; the chicken covers about **36%** of its plate. The ice cream estimate is less certain because its contents are wrapped.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **368 g of edible food and 712 kcal** is plausible for the visible chicken portion, light salad, dressing and mini ice cream. The chicken skin, dressing and chocolate coating account for much of the energy.
